issue: Immediate retry after an image-data-preparation processingError could reuse the same failing in-memory File until a full page reload reconstructed it from IndexedDB.
fix: Paused retry at stage 画像データ準備 reloads only the failed image from the checkpoint files store and reconstructs a fresh File/Blob before restarting the batch.
The reconstructed source is marked stable so stableImageSource does not call arrayBuffer() on the original failing File again.
File.arrayBuffer() preparation is bounded by a 15 second timeout so a browser-side stalled read cannot hang indefinitely.
Other processingError stages retain the existing retry behavior.
